description: Audit sitemap coverage, orphan-page candidates, important URLs, canonical/indexability noise, and internal-link gaps. Uses AgentSEO credits; repeating the call can create new charged work.

crawl_urls.description: Previously collected crawl or analytics records to compare with the sitemap; these records are not a new full-site crawl request. Type: Array. Maximum: 5000 items. Default: [].

items.description: One supplied crawl or analytics observation for a page. Type: Object. Required.

canonical_url.description: Absolute canonical URL reported for this supplied page. Type: String. Format: absolute URL. Optional; no client default.

clicks.description: Count of search clicks in your supplied reporting window; use the same window across compared records. Type: Number. Minimum: 0. Optional; no client default.

impressions.description: Count of search impressions in your supplied reporting window; use the same window across compared records. Type: Number. Minimum: 0. Optional; no client default.

inbound_internal_links.description: Count of incoming internal links observed for this supplied page. Type: Safe integer. Minimum: 0. Optional; no client default.

indexable.description: Whether this supplied page is considered indexable according to your crawl evidence. Type: Boolean. Default: true.

source.description: Label identifying the origin of this supplied crawl record, for example a crawler or Search Console export. Type: String. Maximum: 80 characters. Optional; no client default.

status_code.description: HTTP response status code, for example 200 or 404; not an application job status. Type: Safe integer. Minimum: 100. Maximum: 599. Optional; no client default.

title.description: Title of the supplied page or work item, used as its human-readable label. Type: String. Maximum: 180 characters. Optional; no client default.

url.description: Absolute URL identifying this supplied crawl observation; not an instruction to crawl that page again. Type: String. Format: absolute URL. Required.

important_urls.description: Important absolute page URLs that should be checked for sitemap coverage. Type: Array. Maximum: 500 items. Default: [].

items.description: One important absolute web page URL to check for sitemap coverage. Type: String. Format: absolute URL. Required.

internal_links.description: Supplied internal-link edges to use for coverage and orphan-page analysis. Type: Array. Maximum: 20000 items. Default: [].

items.description: One observed internal-link edge with source and destination URLs. Type: Object. Required.

anchor.description: Visible anchor text of the supplied link. Type: String. Maximum: 160 characters. Optional; no client default.

source_url.description: Source page URL associated with this record or analysis; use an absolute web URL. Type: String. Format: absolute URL. Required.

target_url.description: Absolute destination page URL of the supplied internal link. Type: String. Format: absolute URL. Required.

max_sitemap_children.description: Maximum child sitemap documents to inspect from a sitemap index; zero disables child fetching. Type: Safe integer. Minimum: 0. Maximum: 10. Default: 3.

sitemap_url.description: Accessible XML sitemap or sitemap-index URL; supply this or sitemap_xml. Type: String. Format: absolute URL. Optional; no client default.

sitemap_xml.description: XML sitemap or sitemap-index content supplied directly instead of fetching sitemap_url. Type: String. Minimum: 80 characters. Maximum: 2000000 characters. Optional; no client default.

sync.description: Request a bounded wait for completion when true. The API can still return a pending job; retain its job ID and poll agentseo_job_status instead of repeating this charged call. False returns a queued job without waiting. Type: Boolean. Default: true.

target.description: Your target brand, domain or URL used to scope this workflow; supply the entity you want assessed. Type: String. Optional; no client default.

name: agentseo_site_sitemap_audit
title: AgentSEO Sitemap Audit
